brand.note: The logo system from Theo's brand board. The board's five brand colours are the colour tokens santan, pisang, cabai, kecap and gula, hex for hex, and a test holds them to it. The mark is a shuttle climbing out of layered exhaust in a brown roundel, with the nutrient icons — bolt, leaf, dumbbell, cross — orbiting it.

lockups.name: primary
lockups.description: Circular badge: roundel, shuttle, exhaust clouds and the wordmark inside the ring.
lockups.usage: Splash screen, the Learn section's cover, anywhere the brand is introduced rather than referenced. Needs room — below about 96px the wordmark inside the ring stops resolving.

lockups.name: secondary
lockups.description: Horizontal: shuttle left, wordmark right on the diagonal.
lockups.usage: Headers, the coach dashboard's top bar, letterheads. The default where width is cheaper than height.

lockups.name: stacked
lockups.description: Shuttle above the wordmark, no roundel.
lockups.usage: Narrow columns, portrait splash, the pitch deck's title slide.

lockups.name: submark
lockups.description: Roundel and shuttle only, no wordmark.
lockups.usage: The app icon, the favicon, an avatar, a loading state. The one lockup that reads at 48px and below.

rules: The wordmark is PiePie and is drawn, not typeset. Never re-set it in a font.
Place the mark on santan or on kecap. The roundel already carries its own dark ground, so it needs no plate on a light surface.
Do not recolour the mark to a single flat colour, and do not drop the exhaust from the lockups that have it — the climb is the idea.
Clear space on every side is the height of the F in FUEL.
Nothing is the logo except these four files. The app never composes a lockup at runtime.

typography.display: PiePie Regular — the wordmark and every display style.
typography.supporting: Josefin Sans — the board names Regular for supporting text; the app also uses 600 and 700 for headings and buttons, which the board does not forbid.

tokens.name: santan
tokens.usage: Brand cream, #F6EED3. The ground of both brand boards, the app’s ground in light, and all text on dark fills. Named for coconut milk.

tokens.name: pisang
tokens.usage: Brand amber, #F6AA32. The lightning roundel on the logo board and the C planet on the mascot sheet. The hero: carbohydrate, the fuel ring, the primary button, the streak. Named for the banana the Week 1 material keeps recommending.

tokens.name: cabai
tokens.usage: Brand orange-red, #FC5B27. The shuttle’s nose and its exhaust. Protein, intensity and the attention state. Named for chilli.

tokens.name: gula
tokens.usage: Brand mid-brown, #8C7359. The mascot suit’s webbing and straps. Secondary chrome. Named for gula merah, palm sugar.

tokens.name: kecap
tokens.usage: Brand dark brown, #523123. The mascot sheet’s wordmark. The Learn domain and dark fills that take cream text at 9.9:1. Named for kecap manis.

tokens.name: langit
tokens.usage: Brand navy, #0A2639. The sky behind the shuttle on the icon lockup, and so the app icon’s own ground. The dark theme’s surface, which makes the splash continue straight into the app. Named for langit, sky.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App background. The board’s cream in light, the icon’s own navy in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the meal timeline. One step lighter than surface so cards lift.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Progress tracks, empty slots, input wells. One step darker so they recede.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers and unfilled borders. Never for text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text. Aliases kecap in light and santan in dark. 9.9:1 on surface in light, 13.4:1 in dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, units, timestamps. 6.0:1 on surface in light, 8.4:1 in dark. It no longer aliases gula: the board’s mid-brown reaches only 3.8:1 on the board’s cream, so it stays a graphic colour rather than text.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels only. Below 4.5:1 by design, so never for content a reader must act on.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Label on cabai, kecap, fill-alert, air-deep and daun-deep fills. Cream, never white — white on these is harsher than the boards intend.

tokens.name: on-bright
tokens.usage: Label on pisang and daun, which stay bright in both themes. Dark in both themes too, so it never flips with ink. 7.5:1 on pisang, 6.6:1 on daun.

tokens.name: fill-alert
tokens.usage: The fill of a destructive button, in both themes. Takes on-fill at 5.8:1. cabai itself is too bright to carry cream text, so it stays a graphic colour.

tokens.name: locked
tokens.usage: Locked lesson nodes and disabled button fills.

tokens.name: pisang-deep
tokens.usage: pisang as text on a light surface or on pisang-tint. 5.5:1 in light, 7.4:1 in dark. Not an under-edge — that is pisang-edge.

tokens.name: pisang-tint
tokens.usage: Carbohydrate card backgrounds and the unfilled portion of a carb ring.

tokens.name: cabai-deep
tokens.usage: cabai as text on a surface or on cabai-tint. 5.6:1 in light, 6.8:1 in dark.

tokens.name: cabai-tint
tokens.usage: Flag rows on the coach dashboard, missed meal slots.

tokens.name: kecap-tint
tokens.usage: Learn tab backgrounds and diet-quality cards.

tokens.name: langit-tint
tokens.usage: Panels that belong to the icon’s own world — the splash and the brand header. Navy at low strength in light, raised navy in dark.

tokens.name: daun
tokens.usage: Brand green, #A6B385. The natural-nutrients planet’s light tone. Success, go, streak kept, vegetables. Identical in both themes, like pisang, because it is a button fill. Takes on-bright at 6.6:1.

tokens.name: daun-deep
tokens.usage: daun as text on a surface or on daun-tint. 6.4:1 in light, 7.3:1 in dark.

tokens.name: daun-tint
tokens.usage: Completed meal slots, success banners.

tokens.name: air
tokens.usage: Brand teal, #406C79. The magnesium planet. Hydration: fluid intake, the urine scale chrome, water targets. The one cool hue the app needs, and now a board colour rather than an invented one.

tokens.name: air-deep
tokens.usage: air as text on a surface or on air-tint. 6.8:1 in light, 7.8:1 in dark.

tokens.name: air-tint
tokens.usage: Hydration card backgrounds.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 3px focus outline on every interactive element. Deliberately the one cool colour, so focus never reads as a filled brand state.

tokens.name: pisang-edge
tokens.usage: The 4px under-edge of a pisang button. Dark in both themes, because an edge is a shadow, not text.

tokens.name: daun-edge
tokens.usage: Under-edge of a daun button.

tokens.name: cabai-edge
tokens.usage: Under-edge of a cabai button.

tokens.name: air-edge
tokens.usage: Under-edge of an air button, and the hydration button’s own fill. Takes on-fill in both themes.

tokens.name: kecap-edge
tokens.usage: Under-edge of a kecap button.

tokens.name: kecap-deep
tokens.usage: kecap as text, or as a bar fill, on a surface or on kecap-tint. 8.8:1 in light, 8.5:1 in dark.

styles.name: stat-hero
styles.usage: The number inside the fuel ring. Tabular figures, counts up on load.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Card headlines and the streak count.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Adding a bowl of nasi at dinner closes most of that gap.
styles.usage: Advice card body and lesson copy. Sized up a step for Josefin's small x-height.

styles.name: body-m
styles.usage: Default UI text, food rows, list detail.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Macro detail under a food row, helper text. Do not go below this — Josefin's lowercase is small for its point size.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Push button labels. Josefin tops out at 700, so this is its heaviest weight.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and chips. Josefin's caps are its strongest feature — use them here.

spacing.note: A 4px base grid. Every gap and inset is one of these; nothing is hand-tuned.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row inset.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the screen side gutter. The default.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space above a screen's primary action.

radius.note: Generous and even, to match PiePie's rounded terminals. Nothing has a sharp corner except the tab bar's bottom edge.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, the urine scale swatches.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Food rows and small controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Push buttons and cards. The signature radius.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets, the advice card, celebration panels, cover blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Progress tracks, lesson nodes, avatars.

shadow.note: Hard offsets, no blur. Depth comes from a solid under-edge, the way a physical key sits proud of its board. One blurred shadow exists, on modals.

tokens.name: edge-button
tokens.usage: The 4px under-edge on a push button at rest. Collapses to 0 on press.

tokens.name: edge-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards and food rows.

tokens.name: float-modal
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the celebration overlay only. The one blurred shadow in the system.
